caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain light beige background. The object is a mask-like face, primarily colored in shades of dark brown and gray with a slightly shiny texture, suggesting it could be made of metal or wood. The face has pronounced and exaggerated features, including high-arched eyebrows, closed eyes, a broad nose, and a prominent mustache and beard that extends downward, merging into ornamental, leaf-like forms. The forehead and cheeks show additional stylized leaf motifs that flow outward and upward, creating a symmetrical, winged effect on both sides of the head. The mask's mouth is slightly open, with what appears to be a small object or leaf resting on the tongue, and two small circular details are present near the cheeks, resembling studs or earrings. The drawing is composed with the face isolated in the center, and there are no other objects or background details.
title: Plaque
